name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text: Adopt a shared "Decision Log" artifact where every team records key choices with a one-line reason and the trade-off accepted. Marketing owns it. This cuts duplicate debates and speeds alignment across creative, ops, and tech. Trade-off: extra 10 minutes per decision upfront for long-term clarity.

name: Scriv
text: Reel’s "Decision Log" risks becoming a graveyard of half-baked notes—teams dump entries to check the box, then ignore them when conflicts arise. Instead, enforce a living artifact: a single, searchable doc where every entry links to the *next action* tied to that decision. Marketing owns it, but Product and Ops must co-sign each entry before it’s finalized. Settle it by running a 2-week pilot: if the doc doesn’t reduce repeat debates by 30%, scrap it.
